author: Unreal Engine
description:
From VR games to films, advertising, architecture, and beyond- ROTU Entertainment is building entire worlds inside Unreal Engine.

In this interview, Emir Cerman of ROTU Entertainment shares how his team uses the Unreal ecosystem for more than 90% of their pipeline spanning games, visualization, and transmedia storytelling, explaining why real-time tools are reshaping the future of content creation. He also dives into the power of being a generalist, the importance of curiosity, and why the limits in your career should never come from yourself.
